Olivia (AE): FYI — BlueHarbor wants a 3-week pilot for contract search + clause extraction. Key constraints: some docs up to ~70k tokens, strict EU residency, and a monthly pilot cap of $9k.
Marco (SE): Need to confirm peak QPS and expected concurrency. Ask them for an eval set.
Olivia (AE): They said 120 QPS burst, concurrency moderate. Will send eval set after NDA.
Sofia (ML Eng): Two recommended approaches: 1) chunked embedding + rerank (32k reranker) — cost predictable; 2) experimental long-context single-pass (>=100k) — higher cost and needs Private. Recommend offering both in SOW.
Ken (Security): They insist on BYO-KMS or approved HSM, audit logs, and cipher suites. Also want retention policy for temporary unredacted text.
Marco (SE): Proposed chunking: 8k windows with 1.5k overlap -> embed -> top-200 retrieval -> rerank. We'll add prefix caching for hot docs.
Sofia (ML Eng): For 4M docs, estimated chunk count ~7M; with 1536-dim embeddings and int8 PQ we can keep the index compact.
Olivia (AE): Can the demo show function/tool calls for redaction + signer? Customer expects that flow.
Marco (SE): Yes — demo will stub a redaction service and a signing service. Production will swap in their HSM.
infra-bot: sandbox allocation: blueharbor-poc-sandbox reserved 2026-06-10T09:30Z (ticket#9021)
Sofia (ML Eng): Draft acceptance metrics for SOW: clause extraction F1 >= 0.88; search recall >= 0.80 at top-50; end-to-end p95 <= 800ms under stated burst.
Ken (Security): I'll start the questionnaire answers. Need to know log retention default and whether customer can bring keys into Private.
Marco (SE): Private supports BYO-HSM; hosted supports envelope encryption with customer-managed keys. I'll prep a short diagram and SOC2 attestation.
Olivia (AE): Action items: Olivia to request eval set + sec contact; Marco to prepare SOC2 + VPC diagram; Sofia to build eval harness and baseline metrics. Review SOW draft Friday?
All: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
